Aircraft.name: KT Veleten - AI
Aircraft.Instructions:
KT Veleten By: Shizzle Styx
AG1: Opens rear cargo door AG2: Opens nose cargo door AG3: Deploys cockpit ramp AG4: Activates magnets AG5-8: Free
Flaps: Deploys flaps at negative %s VTOL: Lowers the cargo bay magnets at negative %s Trim: Trims aircraft pitch controls
Notes: This thicc boi saw more changes in its development than it had any right to. Originally the craft started out being called "The Chonk" and was effectively an unholy mashup of the A400M and the Piaggio P-180 Avanti. And then I thought "what if... longer?" I then proceeded to make it longer, slapped on a twin tail and extra turboprops like a mad lad. Playtesters loved the now dubbed "Tiny Tucker", but requested an upper deck and a nose cargo door. And now... well... Cursed AN225. I didn't set out to make the AN225, but like a loose fart in a lift, it's here now and there's not a lot you can do about it... Speaking of: did I mention an earlier version also used to have a lift too?
